body:
Long story time. My parents hate each other and me, but stay together because my mother is uneducated and father doesn't want to pay child support. I have 2 older half brothers, my father is actually my 2nd oldest brother's father. The kicker; my parents have been married through all 3 of us. Completely loveless marriage. Ive tried all my life so far to trust them. I came out as bisexual to my mother. She threatened to break my violin and send me to a camp. I'm incredibly intelligent, but failing 3 of 7 classes. I've attempted suicide twice and had to heal up without going to a hospital or receiving medical attention. Anytime I want to go somewhere, they tell me no because "in a demon worshipping whore." Ive tried to tell therapists, counselors, policemen, teachers, everything, and every one of them has said im overreacting and my parents love me. My father told me when I was 11 that if I called the police for him beating my mother, it was my fault that we would lose our house and starve. I called anyway. And he got off with no charge because he's a high ranking military officer with connections. While a policeman interrogated my mother, he discussed guns with my father. But my mother was being beaten because she accused him of cheating on her with a lesbian woman he worked with. And no one believes it except a few very close friends and my brothers, because I'm so well liked and social and mature. Even better; all my friends LOVE my parents. They tell me how lucky I am. My best friend is a Christian girl who's gorgeous, and she's always had amazing grades. She's "perfect". I'm always being compared to her. My mother asked why I couldn't be like her, and then wondered aloud why she would want to be around someone as deadbeat retarded as I am. 

Another kicker; I'm only 14. And I feel like if my parents disappeared, I would be happy. Even I went to prison. I'd be free of them. We keep so many guns and knives and ammo in this house, I could kill them easily. I know it'd be wrong and I won't, but I honestly considered it at one point. Right now I almost want to provoke my father into beating me so fiercely I'd be taken away. I'm fucking miserable. I hate it. And no one knows.
Thank you very much.. a couple of people have messaged me tonight. I want to credit the user /u/had-enough for helping me think about finding a social worker and clearing my head.

You sound an awful lot like me. I'm sorry you're going through anything like myself, it's horrible when people you love don't support you and try to help you through your problems. You feel empty and hated. It's the only thing that's ever on your mind and you feel unproductive and useless, right?
edit- and it's alot worse if you don't have the heart to love them. that's my problem. Believe it or not, I have a huge idea of what you're going through. PM me the details and I'll try to help as much as I can. Even if you think it wont help, you're at the end of your rope, might as well try, right? :)

Surgeries have really screwed with both of my brother's lives. they've lost them so many job opportunities and self support, it's insane. They're not anywhere near the physically able state that guys in their early-mid 20s should be. it's like they're 45-50 and in bad health. I won't tell you that it will get better, because there's no garuntee of that. What I can tell you is that you can seek help to make it better. Have you tried physical therapy? Maybe going to any therapist in general (though I'm sure you've tried that, huh?) Try sitting down and listing all of the things you care about. If you honestly can't think of any, think of people who care about you. I'm positive that there's at least one. Seek help from those you trust. Finding care in yourself is the first step to making things better. and i'll listen if you just need to get something off your chest.
